messages.text: Add a rate limiter that allows at most 2 requests per account per minute. Requests from different IP addresses for the same account must share the limit. Different accounts must have independent limits.
I will key a fixed-window counter by client IP and test that repeated requests from one IP are limited.

criteria.requirement: All requests for one account share a maximum of 2 requests in the same minute, across client IP addresses.
A different account has an independent allowance.
